web/internal/reply#

Shared response assembly for web/reply and web/exception.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

Shared response assembly for web/reply and web/exception. A reply owns its representation and framing fields; the headers a caller gives may carry any other field, but never Content-Type, Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding.

object OpenedReplyResponse#

object OpenedReplyResponse

The response of a reply whose body is opened as it is sent: a stream, a file, events. The reply gives its own fields (Content-Type, and Content-Length when it knows the length).
